headline: Session delivered in full — 8/8 reps at target HR, compliance 112%
summary: Both series completed as prescribed: 8x4min at 8% incline, HR sitting right in the 167-172 band (avg 151 overall, max 175 — the stop-rule threshold of 175 was touched but not breached, and no "cut to 6%" trigger fired). RPE 7, feel 2/5 — a real but appropriate grind for the last VO2 stimulus 11 days out. Logged load is 85, but per the treadmill-incline discrepancy that's really closer to 105-110 of true stimulus, matching the prescribed 105 — reps-completed and RPE confirm the session hit as planned, not the raw number. No knee or pain flags reported.
flags: Feel 2/5 on an RPE7 session worth watching — not a red flag alone, but combined with last week's underdelivered easy days/overdelivered quality pattern, keep an eye on accumulating fatigue into Thu's 2x20min.
HRV 69 / RHR 48 this morning was comfortably clear of the stop-rule gate (HRV<55 or RHR 52+), so full 2x4 was the correct call.
suggestedChange: None needed — session matched plan. Just keep Wed's easy 72min Z2 genuinely easy to bank recovery before Thu's threshold work.
